observed.stuckChildClass: Unity.ILPP.Runner plus UnityAutoQuitter remained live after the receipt and shutdown sequence

diagnosis: The source compiled and Burst's current compilation predicate became stably done, but the source-triggered IL post-processing process did not drain; an internal PASS receipt alone is insufficient without natural process exit.
forwardRepair: Perform the next readiness check in the now-compiled cache state, using the same guard and no source edits between attempts. This distinguishes first-import ILPP teardown from executable code defects.
